versions.subject: rule: Raccine uninstall
versions.detection:
selection1:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'taskkill '
        - '/IM RaccineSettings.exe'        
selection2:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'reg.exe'
        - 'delete'
        - 'Raccine Tray'
selection3:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'schtasks'
        - '/DELETE'
        - 'Raccine Rules Updater'
condition: 1 of them
versions.spl: (CommandLine="*taskkill *" CommandLine="*/IM RaccineSettings.exe*") OR (CommandLine="*reg.exe*" CommandLine="*delete*" CommandLine="*Raccine Tray*") OR (CommandLine="*schtasks*" CommandLine="*/DELETE*" CommandLine="*Raccine Rules Updater*")
